label: to review
research: The archival abstract names Hans Rosenberg only as a neighbor on Maximinstraße. Joh. and Katharina Rosenberg bought a cottage in St. Maximinien/Umstraße in 1655_2.json, but similarity of name and location does not establish that Hans is Joh. or connect them to a known family. The Aachen and Franconian groups are possible comparisons, not supported identifications; attribution remains unresolved. Kreisarchiv Viersen identifies C 1 as Kempen’s charter collection, and 1655_2.json explicitly equates St. Maximinien with Kempen’s Umstraße. That supports a single neighborhood context for Hans and the 1655 purchasers. Family attribution remains open until another deed or parish entry identifies the household or its origins. https://www.archive.nrw.de/kreisarchiv-viersen

entries.german:
Die Eheleute Jelis Huitges oder Pelssers und Marga

Die Eheleute Jelis Huitges oder Pelssers und Margaretha verkaufen an die Eheleute Adolph und Sibilla Mörses ihr Haus und ihren Garten in der Maximinstraße neben Hans Rosenberg.

Schöffenbrief mit gewöhnlichem Siegel
entries.english:
The spouses Jelis Huitges or Pelssers and Margaretha sell their house and garden in Maximinstraße next to Hans Rosenberg to the spouses Adolph and Sibilla Mörses.
